svg.title: Memory allocated per encode call, relative to @mapbox/polyline
svg.desc: Heap plus typed arrays and WASM memory, divided by @mapbox/polyline's at the same size, log scale. Down is less memory. polytini 0.1.0, default import. Median of 3 rounds in fresh processes, 2026-11-26. Bun isn't measured (see docs/methodology.md). Groups are points per line. Node 24.22.3: 100 points: polytini 0.1.0 0.07x, @googlemaps/polyline-codec 1.31x, google-polyline 0.70x, @placemarkio/polyline 0.98x, @pirxpilot/google-polyline 0.74x; 10k points: polytini 0.1.0 0.04x, @googlemaps/polyline-codec 2.78x, google-polyline 1.07x, @placemarkio/polyline 1.00x, @pirxpilot/google-polyline 1.07x; 100k points: polytini 0.1.0 0.20x, @googlemaps/polyline-codec 2.69x, google-polyline 1.08x, @placemarkio/polyline 1.00x, @pirxpilot/google-polyline 1.08x. Deno 2.5.4: 100 points: polytini 0.1.0 0.59x, @googlemaps/polyline-codec 1.07x, google-polyline 0.56x, @placemarkio/polyline 0.95x, @pirxpilot/google-polyline 0.60x; 10k points: polytini 0.1.0 0.04x, @googlemaps/polyline-codec 2.78x, google-polyline 1.07x, @placemarkio/polyline 1.00x, @pirxpilot/google-polyline 1.07x; 100k points: polytini 0.1.0 0.20x, @googlemaps/polyline-codec 2.69x, google-polyline 1.08x, @placemarkio/polyline 1.00x, @pirxpilot/google-polyline 1.08x.
